title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-27
lineage: PCM -> Peak -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Phat soundboard capture of a mixed performance, highlighted by a smoking Playing in the Band but hampered by a lackluster Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its excellent PCM‑transfer soundboard quality – listeners call it “phat” and “fantastic”. The show itself is described as uneven: a loose, sometimes sloppy set with standout jams on Playing In The Band and The Wheel, while Jerry’s guitar feels uninspired and The Other One never really takes off.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews give an average star rating of 4.25; most praise the recording while noting mixed show quality, leading to a strong overall score with high confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers highlight a superb PCM transfer that lifts an otherwise poor‑sounding source; the sound is described as crisp, phat, and fantastic throughout.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Inconsistent – a few high‑energy jams are offset by overall sloppiness and uneven pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Playing seems uninspired according to reviewers.
band_member_comments.Phil: Presence noted positively; Phil is “on” and contributes solid bass work.
